親愛的教職員生：

適逢清明連假，K書中心A館於114/4/3(四)~114/4/7(一)
休館五日

K書中心B館維持24小時開放使用
敬請遵守使用規範

教學卓越中心 敬啟
--------------------------------------------------------
Dear Faculty, Staff, and Students,

During the Qingming Festival holiday, K Study Center Building A will be closed for five days from April 3 (Thursday) to April 7 (Monday), 2025.
K Study Center Building B will remain open 24 hours as usual.
Please adhere to the usage regulations.

Best regards,

Center for Teaching Excellence
